name: kit-turn
description: A plain-language summary card at the end of every turn: what Claude did, the files it changed (+/- per file), tests that ran, how long it took, and a warning with a one-press prompt when commits are not pushed. Choose a card or a timeline. Also a live turn clock, a /turn command and a Vietnamese interface.

style.title: Style of the summary
style.description: card: a card with sections (Done, Changes, Checks, Time). timeline: one line per step with the clock time, then the result. Both collapse to one line when there is little room.

showClock.title: Show the turn clock while Claude works
showClock.description: While a turn runs, show when it started and how long it has been going, in the band and the status line. Off: no clock.

showBand.title: Show the summary above the prompt
showBand.description: Turn off to hide the band. The /turn command and the pane keep working.

language.title: Language of the card, pane and /turn
language.description: auto: Vietnamese when Claude Code's own language setting is Vietnamese, English otherwise (looked up once at session start). en: always English. vi: always Vietnamese (Tiếng Việt). The prompt that Push now sends to Claude stays English.

maxFiles.title: Files listed in the card
maxFiles.description: How many changed files the card lists before "+N more". Whole number from 1 to 30; a value outside that range is cut to it.
